proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON RETIREMENT PLAN OPTIONS
proposals.proponent: Sara Sackner, represented by As You Sow
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a Board report on how the Company protects 401(k) Plan beneficiaries with longer horizons from climate risk in default retirement investment options.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on retirement plan options.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON CUSTOMER DUE DILIGENCE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party report assessing customer due diligence to determine whether customers' use of surveillance, computer vision or cloud products contributes to human rights violations.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on customer due diligence

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING REPORTING ON CONTENT AND PRODUCT REMOVAL/RESTRICTIONS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests revised transparency reporting with detailed quantitative disclosures on content and product removals or restrictions due to government requests or voluntary actions.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting reporting on content and product removal/restrictions.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON CONTENT REMOVAL REQUESTS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semi-annual published report itemizing U.S. government takedown requests and the Company's responses and rationale.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on content removal requests.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ADDITIONAL REPORTING ON STAKEHOLDER IMPACTS
proposals.proponent: International Brotherhood of Teamsters General Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on how the climate strategy addresses impacts on employees, supply chain workers and communities, consistent with Just Transition guidelines.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that shareholders vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ALTERNATIVE TAX REPORTING
proposals.proponent: Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate – United States Province
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a tax transparency report prepared under the GRI Tax Standard, including country-by-country reporting.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting alternative tax reporting.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ADDITIONAL REPORTING ON CLIMATE LOBBYING
proposals.proponent: Eric and Emily Johnson and Mercy Rome, represented by Newground Social Investment
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the framework for addressing misalignments between Amazon's lobbying and trade association activities and its Net Zero climate commitments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on climate lobbying.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ADDITIONAL REPORTING ON GENDER/RACIAL PAY
proposals.proponent: Anne Bartol Butterfield, represented by Arjuna Capital
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on median pay gaps across race and gender, including associated risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on gender/​racial pay.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ANALYSIS OF COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PROGRAMS
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a cost/benefit analysis of the Company's Diversity, Equity and Inclusion programs.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an analysis of costs associated with diversity, equity, and inclusion programs.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN AMENDMENT TO OUR BYLAWS TO REQUIRE SHAREHOLDER APPROVAL FOR CERTAIN FUTURE AMENDMENTS
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie, represented by John Chevedden
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw amendment requiring shareholder approval for certain advance notice bylaw amendments affecting director nominations.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an amendment to our bylaws to require shareholder approval for certain future amendments.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ADDITIONAL REPORTING ON FREEDOM OF ASSOCIATION
proposals.proponent: Catherine Donnelly Foundation, represented by the Shareholder Association for Research & Education
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party assessment of adherence to workers' freedom of association and collective bargaining commitments.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends shareholders vote against the proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A NEW POLICY REGARDING OUR EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION PROCESS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the compensation committee consider pay grades and salary ranges of all employees when setting senior executive target pay.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a new policy regarding our executive compensation process.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ADDITIONAL REPORTING ON ANIMAL WELFARE STANDARDS
proposals.proponent: MacConnel Lowe Trust, represented by People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating the efficacy and shortcomings of Whole Foods' animal welfare standards and auditing procedures.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on animal welfare standards.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ADDITIONAL BOARD COMMITTEE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board establish a Public Policy Committee to oversee public policy issues including human rights, climate and unionization.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an additional Board committee.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ALTERNATIVE DIRECTOR CANDIDATE POLICY
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the initial director candidate list include hourly employees.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an alternative director candidate policy.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON WAREHOUSE WORKING CONDITIONS
proposals.proponent: Thomas Dadashi Tazehozi, represented by Tulipshare Limited
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent audit and report on working conditions and treatment of Amazon warehouse workers, including injury rates.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on warehouse working conditions.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON PACKAGING MATERIALS
proposals.proponent: The George Gund Foundation, represented by As You Sow
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on how the Company could reduce plastics use in packaging to significantly reduce ocean plastic pollution.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that shareholders vote against this proposal.

proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent study of Rekognition's privacy and civil rights risks and potential sales to repressive governments.
